content:
maria: spotted an odd billing line: small streaming job shows provisional +8 then final -20, net -12. Customer ticket.
kevin: paste logs?
maria: logging snippet attached: 
```
2026-05-10T09:14:02Z router: session=usr-88 route=us-east-1 -> us-west-2 reason=model_fallback
2026-05-10T09:14:02Z runtime: session=usr-88 prefix_len=12 tokens_emitted=40 status=streaming
2026-05-10T09:14:03Z runtime: session=usr-88 toolcall=translate_v2 truncated=true tokens_tool=8
2026-05-10T09:14:04Z runtime: session=usr-88 model=vicuna-13b-quant2 variant=faster shard=billing-model-vicuna
2026-05-10T09:14:05Z billing: session=usr-88 provisional_credit=+8 owner=billing-region-us-east
2026-05-10T09:14:07Z billing: session=usr-88 reconcile_adjust=-20 owner=billing-model-vicuna
```
kevin: interesting: provisional credit used route-based owner (us-east) but reconcile adjust used model-variant owner (billing-model-vicuna). ledger keys differ -> cross-owner inconsistency.
sam: so ownership is determined differently at provisional write vs reconcile? we've seen route_tag vs model_owner splits before but not mixed in one flow.
irene: runtime change in March updated reconcile to attribute confirmed cost to the model owner tag for accounting accuracy, but provisional still uses route_tag for fast-path. if a model fallback happens mid-stream, owner flips.
leila: that creates a transient where provisional sits on one owner and final lands on another -> console shows negative on origin owner and a separate positive on model owner; customers get confused.
kevin: two possible fixes: A) canonical ownership id attached to the session at start and preserved across handoffs/fallbacks; B) include provenance pointer on provisional writes and have reconcile merge across owners using provenance id.
maria: option A could misattribute cost in cases where the model is intentionally routed to cheaper variants. we want final attribution to reflect the final model.
ben: option B seems better: keep provisional attribution fast (route-based) but attach a provenance key (session|start_owner) that reconcile uses to find and merge provisional entries before applying final adjustments. that preserves final attribution while preventing negative display.
sam: ledger needs to support cross-owner provisional lookups by provenance id. currently shards are keyed by owner -> we'd have to implement a lightweight secondary index or a two-phase reconcile read. performance impact?\eire: (typo) irene: two-phase reconcile read sounds OK if we limit lookups to sessions with a provenance mismatch. add a cheap hash map of recent provenance -> owner mappings to avoid scanning.
kevin: instrumentation idea: when provisional write occurs, emit provenance metadata {prov_id, owner_at_write}. Reconcile reads prov_id from final event and tries prov_lookup(prov_id) first. If found on a different owner, merge the provisional record and then apply final adjust to final owner.
leila: console UX: show a combined "session-level pending" row that groups provisional + pending reconciles by prov_id for 24h so customers don't see standalone negatives. link to trace.
maria: short-term bandaid: hide single-session negatives under X tokens until reconcile or 24h. we'll do this while infra changes land.
ben: ops-bot: created INC-2026-261 assigned eng-platform.
ops-bot: canary plan: provenance field in provisional write + reconcile lookup, staged at 5% traffic.
sam: tests: simulate model fallback mid-stream and a toolcall truncated before and after fallback. ensure ledger merge removes negative. I'll add test harness.
kevin: plan:
- runtime: attach prov_id on provisional writes (0.5d)
- reconcile: probe provenance index if owner mismatch and merge provisional (2d)
- ledger: small secondary index for recent prov_id -> owner mapping with TTL (1d)
- console: group pending rows and hide tiny negatives (0.5d)
Total: ~4 days.
irene: add alert: cross-owner negative rate > 1/min -> pager.
leila: I'll draft customer-facing note and support template.
ben: summarize: root cause = inconsistent owner selection (route vs model-owner) when fallback happens mid-stream + truncation; fix = provenance attach + reconcile merge + console grouping.
maria: thanks. I'll open the UI PR for the short-term hide and the support template.
kevin: PRs: runtime r/5132, reconcile r/5135, ledger r/5136, console r/5137, tests r/5138.
ops-bot: INC-2026-261 status: monitoring.
